_comment: Route-contract inventory for the #389 audit (machine-checked half; the human-readable contract table is docs/api/route-contract-inventory.md). Every entry must resolve to a live handler (file + method + decorator path), so the inventory cannot rot when a route moves or dies. Dispositions: 'implemented' (real operation against a named canonical owner), 'unsupported-501' (explicit refusal — the operation is not implemented and says so), 'preview' (deliberately non-durable surface, marked in the OpenAPI schema), 'temporary' (a canned handler that must carry an issue and an expires date; the gate refuses it once expired). A canned handler that is NOT registered fails scripts/check-api-route-contracts.py outright.

routes.contract: Re-read the settings record from its durable store and return the fresh revision; 503 when the store read fails.
The settings-change trail: entries whose action concerns /v1/settings writes, newest first, from the one durable audit log. Empty means none recorded.
The provider usage panel, served by the same LiteLLM-backed aggregation as GET /v1/quotas/providers (same envelope; state distinguishes ok / no_data / unavailable / error).
Preview overrides: deliberately non-durable, never written to the record, marked 'Preview' in the OpenAPI summary.
Fire receipts (schedule_fire/schedule_run audit entries incl. run ids and refusals) for schedules in Workspaces the caller can see, newest first. Empty means no fire recorded.
The caller's namespaces derived from their own durable entries with real counts and byte sizes. Empty means no entries.
Record a contradiction: increments the entry's durable contradictions count and returns the updated entry. 404 for missing/foreign entries.

Per-provider token usage and request counts aggregated from the LiteLLM spend report, in an envelope whose state distinguishes ok / no_data / unavailable / error; request_count is None when no source reports one.

Success/failure outcome stats for the last 7 days from the canonical outcome store (the same store thumbs feedback writes), in an envelope: ok measured, no_data genuinely empty, error on store failure.
Registered models + metadata from LiteLLM /model/info, in an envelope whose state distinguishes ok / no_data / unavailable / error; unprovided tier/quality/speed stay None.
Refuses with 501: no image build is wired, and the route no longer reports a build that never started.
Refuses with 501: there is no generator; the hard-coded Dockerfile advice was removed.
404 for an unknown server; 501 for a real one — a fabricated 'clean' scan result was removed.
Refuses with 501 and points at POST /v1/mcp/test, the wired connectivity check; the fake 'scanning' status was removed.
Refuses with 501 and points at GET /v1/quotas/models; the baked-in catalog drifted from what the gateway actually registers.
